title: Self Employed Couples Budget Spreadsheet, Tax Pot and Bill Split by Income, Irregular Income Budget Google Sheets Excel, Freelancer Couple
description:
One of you gets a steady paycheck. The other gets paid whenever clients pay. Most couples budgets assume two regular salaries, so the tax money gets spent and every slow month turns into a row.

This Self-Employed Couples Budget fixes the order. The tax pot comes off first. The self-employed partner pays themself the same amount every month, and a buffer covers the low months. Then shared bills are split fairly from that steady pay. One number tells you what is safe to spend together.

WHAT'S INSIDE (9 TABS)
- Dashboard: safe to spend, 9 headline numbers, 5 charts and your next step
- Start Here, Settings, Income Log, Tax Pot (your own tax dates), Buffer, Shared Bills, Monthly Split, Money Talk (12 questions for couples with one business)
- Example copy and blank copy, plus a README with setup steps

WHY IT WORKS
- Few fields: type in the yellow boxes only. Everything else updates on its own (locked in Excel so nothing breaks).
- Split by income, 50-50 or your own %, built in.
- Set your own tax pot %, so it works in the US, UK or anywhere. Any currency.
- Google Sheets (free) and Excel.

Made by a qualified financial planner. A planning tool, not tax advice. Questions: joel@wayofwealthcoaching.com

Digital download: nothing is posted. The photo backgrounds were made with AI; the spreadsheet on every screen and in the video is the real product you download.
